project: Wuxia Life P59 Tavern Hand Merchant-Adjacent Bridge
description: Close a bounded single-origin bridge for tavern_hand by turning the existing guest-network and ally-referral growth signals into a runtime-reachable merchant-adjacent or mixed-adjacent path, without reopening sample lines, deepening merchant_magnate, or expanding into a full tavern or social simulation system.

userStories.title: Audit tavern-hand bridge opportunity
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of the current tavern_hand bridge opportunity so P59 closes a real repo gap instead of inventing a disconnected route.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing tavern_hand growth signals, choice forks, expression surfaces, and mixed or downstream wiring evidence
State that P59 is a merchant-adjacent or mixed-adjacent bridge stage rather than a merchant deepening stage
Identify whether the current missing layer is gate wiring, a bridge checkpoint, or downstream-target definition
Save docs/test-reports/p59-tavern-hand-bridge-gap-audit.md
userStories.notes: Gap audit complete. Missing layer: bridge checkpoint flag + gate wiring + downstream target. Recommended target: merchant_magnate via P55 magnate chain (mirrors P58 apprentice pattern).

userStories.title: Lock P59 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract for P59 so the stage stays single-origin and bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit the stage to tavern_hand only
Define allowed layers: configuration wiring, light bridge expression, targeted proof, narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: sample-line work, merchant magnate deepening, full social system, second ordinary origin in the same stage
Save docs/test-reports/p59-tavern-hand-bridge-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract complete. Single-origin (tavern_hand only), target: merchant_magnate via P55 magnate chain. Forbidden: sample-line reopen, full social sim, farm_peasant bridge, merchant deepening.

userStories.title: Define tavern-hand bridge contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded contract for how tavern_hand guest-network and ally-referral signals graduate into a higher-value route.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a minimal prerequisite group using the existing regular-customer and ally-referral signals
Define at least one explicit bridge checkpoint
State whether the bridge targets a merchant-adjacent route or another existing mixed destiny and justify that choice with repo evidence
Keep tavern_hand ordinary identity intact before the bridge checkpoint fires
userStories.notes: Bridge contract saved at docs/PRD/p59-tavern-hand-bridge-contract.md. Prereq chain: tavern_guest_network → tavern_embrace_network → tavern_take_referral. Checkpoint flag: tavern_merchant_bridge_crossed. Ordinary identity preserved via detectOrdinaryOrigin.

userStories.title: Choose and lock the downstream gate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want P59 to lock one downstream gate so implementation does not sprawl across multiple half-connected routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Choose one primary downstream target from existing destiny or route assets
Explain why this target is preferable to inventing a new destiny
If the target is merchant-adjacent, document the reuse boundary versus the P55 magnate chain
If the target is not merchant-adjacent, document the fit versus P25 ordinary wiring
userStories.notes: Downstream gate locked: merchant_magnate via P55 magnate chain. Entry contract saved at docs/PRD/p59-tavern-hand-magnate-entry-contract.md. Reuses P58 bridge pattern (single flag satisfies both route + milestone conditions). P55 chain itself is not modified.

userStories.title: Wire tavern-hand bridge configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the tavern-hand bridge wired through existing config carriers so it becomes runtime-reachable without a new framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the bridge only through existing origin, route, or destiny configuration carriers
Do not introduce a new origin framework or large new system
The bridged path can enter the chosen downstream gate or produce an equivalent bounded proof path
Existing P56, P58, and P25 ordinary-origin evidence does not regress
userStories.notes: Config wiring complete: take_referral sets route_wealth_committed + tavern_merchant_bridge_crossed; magnate_on_ramp and merchant_midlife_debt gates accept tavern_merchant_bridge_crossed in both conditions. P56/P58 tests pass (no regression).

userStories.title: Add tavern-hand bridge expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the tavern_hand route to visibly read as crossing from local service work into a broader opportunity network.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least two readable bridge signals on existing expression surfaces
Keep the wording distinct from ordinary tavern_hand growth text
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests
userStories.notes: 3 expression signals added: currentGoal (城里铺子已上手，酒肆人脉铺出了商路), lifeMemory (你靠着酒肆积累的人脉进了城里的铺子，从跑堂伙计踏上了商路。), summary (酒肆出身的商人：从跑堂伙计到城里铺子，靠人脉铺出了商路。). Distinct from ordinary midlife text. No new UI components. Tested in p59TavernHandBridgeTests.

userStories.title: Add targeted tavern-hand bridge proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing tavern_hand can reach the chosen downstream gate through the new bridge.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one targeted simulation, replay, or verification artifact
Show tavern seed, bridge checkpoint, and downstream gate evidence in order
Do not rely on direct terminal mixed-flag seeding as the only proof path
Do not require combinatorial exhaust or a full lifetime wave
userStories.notes: Targeted proof saved at docs/test-reports/p59-tavern-hand-magnate-targeted-proof.md. Shows flag chain: tavern_guest_network → tavern_embrace_network → tavern_take_referral → tavern_merchant_bridge_crossed → magnate_on_ramp → magnate chain. Gate evaluation verified via ConditionEvaluator.

userStories.title: Add narrow tavern-hand regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests for the tavern-hand bridge so future edits do not silently collapse it.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover bridge gating, player-facing expression, and proof key assertions with narrow checks
Reuse existing ordinary-origin or mixed harnesses
Do not rewrite the full merchant or ordinary test suites
Relevant commands pass
userStories.notes: 16 tests in tests/p59TavernHandBridgeTests.ts covering: bridge gate flags, prerequisites, currentGoal/lifeMemory/summary expression, ordinary origin preservation, non-tavern isolation, magnate_on_ramp acceptance/rejection, merchant_midlife_debt acceptance, done/orthodox rejection, generic merchant regression, P58 apprentice regression, decline referral no bridge. All pass. P56/P58 regressions also pass.

userStories.title: Produce P59 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what bridge now exists for tavern_hand and what remains deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p59-tavern-hand-bridge-closure-report.md
Summarize configuration, expression, proof, and test evidence
State the boundary versus the P58 apprentice bridge and the P60 peasant design-first stage
List larger social, merchant, or ordinary follow-up items that remain deferred
userStories.notes: Closure report saved at docs/test-reports/p59-tavern-hand-bridge-closure-report.md. Summarizes all 9 stories, config/expression/proof/test evidence, boundaries vs P55/P56/P58/sample-lines/P60, and deferred items.
